# PixShift

> PixShift is a free set of browser-based image tools: compress, resize and convert images. All processing happens locally in the user's browser, so images are never uploaded. No signup, watermark or usage limit.

Replace https://pixshift.example with your real domain before deploying.

## Tools

- [Image Compressor](https://pixshift.example/image-compressor): Reduce the file size of JPG, PNG and WebP images with an adjustable quality slider.
- [Image Resizer](https://pixshift.example/image-resizer): Resize images by exact pixels or percentage, with aspect ratio lock and batch support.
- [JPG Compressor](https://pixshift.example/jpg-compressor): Compress JPG/JPEG photos to a smaller size.
- [PNG Compressor](https://pixshift.example/png-compressor): Shrink PNG files with colour quantization while keeping transparency.
- [WebP Converter](https://pixshift.example/webp-converter): Convert JPG, PNG and other formats to WebP.
- [JPG to PNG](https://pixshift.example/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG/JPEG images to PNG.
- [PNG to JPG](https://pixshift.example/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG images to JPG; transparent areas become white.
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://pixshift.example/aspect-ratio-calculator): Find the simplified ratio of any width and height, and compute matching dimensions.
- [Instagram Image Resizer](https://pixshift.example/instagram-image-resizer): Resize images to Instagram post, portrait, story, reel and profile sizes.
- [LinkedIn Image Resizer](https://pixshift.example/linkedin-image-resizer): Resize images for LinkedIn banners, posts, profile photos and company covers.

## Key facts

- Processing is client-side (browser Canvas API); files are not uploaded.
- Input formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, AVIF (browser dependent). Output formats: JPG, PNG, WebP.
- Free to use, no account required.
